module: D09-14 Market Share／Entry Barrier／Substitution／Competitive Strategy市占、進入障礙、替代與競爭策略
purpose: Freeze new issuer strategic actions before future outcomes are opened, creating the first truly prospective D09-14 cohort.

frozenFacts: New fab-building shell construction to begin at Tainan flagship campus.
Company states near-term capex is aligned with secured long-term customer commitments.
actions.frozenHypothesis: Phased expansion may shorten future capacity lead time while limiting near-term capital overbuild risk.
actions.counterHypothesis: Demand can weaken, customer commitments can change, shell capacity may not become qualified economic capacity, and later capex can still destroy returns.

frozenFacts: Foxconn and Mitsubishi Electric signed an MOU to explore joint operation of automotive equipment business.
Discussion includes potential transfer of 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility shares to Foxconn.
Final agreement remains conditional on commercial terms, negotiations, contract signing and regulatory requirements.
actions.frozenHypothesis: Joint operation could broaden automotive component capability and customer/technology access.
actions.counterHypothesis: MOU may never become a definitive transaction; valuation, governance, integration or regulatory terms may prevent closing.

financial: next 2 reported quarters after material implementation
relativePosition: 24 months where compatible industry denominator exists
preregisteredOutcomeWindows.stockResearch: Blocked. Any later D20/D60/D120-style market outcome test requires separate D16 preregistration, common support and outcome-opening receipt.

futureOutcomeAppendRules: Append only issuer-native or regulator-confirmed milestones on their publication clocks.
Do not retroactively alter the frozen hypothesis/counterhypothesis.
DELAYED != FAILED; MOU_ONLY != COMPLETED; BUILDING_SHELL != QUALIFIED_CAPACITY.
No action success score across incomparable actions.
A later outcome must identify whether it is operational, financial, relative-position or stock-market outcome.
reasonNoL4: L4 requires prospective outcome evidence; this receipt only freezes the pre-outcome cohort and windows. Outcomes remain unknown by design.
exactNext: BR-060 append future operational milestones for these actions only when newly published.
Do not open stock outcomes until separate D16 preregistration authorizes the exact cohort/horizon/baseline.
Add at least two more prospectively frozen actions before any cohort-level inference.
